title: This Is Your Mind On Plants

questions.q: What receptor does caffeine block to increase alertness?
questions.why: The text says caffeine blocks adenosine receptors in the brain.

questions.q: Which plant provides the alkaloid mescaline?
questions.why: Mescaline is described as coming from cacti.

questions.q: What is the main active ingredient in opium?
questions.why: The passage states morphine is the active ingredient in opium.

questions.q: How long can coffee stay in the body, potentially affecting sleep?
questions.why: The text notes coffee can stay in the body for 12 hours.

questions.q: What effect does mescaline have on perception of time?
questions.why: The passage mentions mescaline can alter perception of time, making it feel slower.
